item.title: CVE-2026-99999 — Linux Kernel IPv4 csum_start Validation Flaw (PwnEscape)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.3) — network · CVE-2026-99999. Status: PoC. Affects: Linux kernel IPv4 stack — virtio-net/TAP header translation at ingress (__virtio_net_hdr_to_skb), checksum completion and egress fragmentation (skb_checksum_help, ip_do_fragment). Tags: Linux-kernel, IPv4, virtio-net, TAP, checksum-offload, header-corruption, CWE-20, KVM, QEMU, simulation-only.
